statement: Linux sends IMU enable 0x40 and vibration enable 0x48 as synchronous subcommands with expected 0x21 ACK before completing Pro initialization; report-mode enable 0x03/0x30 occurs between those two. SDL writes 0x48 while opening without treating the return as a required gate and sends 0x40 on sensor enable, not unconditionally on open.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: hid-nintendo.c 1340-1377, 2600-2633; SDL_hidapi_switch.c 930-934, 1536-1567, 1790-1805. Both may inspect incoming input/replies during initialization, but neither source proves full *IMU* streaming before ACK; SDL's selected report mode is hint-dependent.
